title: Build Real Revenue in Just 15 Minutes a Day (No Ads, No Audience)
promo_conflict: The guest, Kyle, promotes his Spark partnership platform (onspark.com, said to hold 'over eight million partners'). He also promotes a free playbook download at onspark.com/hustle. Most business examples are hypothetical outreach scripts or second-hand stories retold by the host. No first-hand revenue numbers are given for Spark.

idea.name: Spark partnership platform
idea.one_liner: Subscription platform that finds, scores and matches partners from a database of 8M+ and auto-crafts and sends partnership outreach
idea.customer: Early-stage founders, side hustlers, creators and enterprise clients
idea.offer: Partner discovery database, AI fit scoring, automated outreach, and the DVLA (discover, verify, launch, amplify) playbook
idea.revenue_model: Subscription (references to 'subscribers'), plus enterprise clients; free playbook as lead magnet

key_quotes.quote: But now systems can do the sourcing, the matching, the follow through,
not only the research, but it'll craft your outreach.
And it will score in a line every single partner to make sure that it's a good fit.
when we talk to our enterprise clients like I hard or HubSpot or Vonage,

claims.claim: Database holds over 8 million partners
claims.quote: So we've loaded over eight million partners onto our database.

claims.claim: 5-10 replies per 100 outreach messages
claims.quote: If you send that out a hundred times, you're going to get five to 10 people that's going to respond

claims.claim: Outreach ends with an ask for a 15-minute call
claims.quote: hey, let's jump on a quick 15 minute call to explore.

acquisition_channels.details: Podcast guest appearance with a free playbook lead magnet at onspark.com/hustle
Partnership with the podcast host

ideas.delivery: Software platform with AI matching and automated outreach; guest also does partnership coaching
ideas.other_uk_rules: Automated outreach sent to UK sole traders or individual creators by email or DM would breach PECR; only corporate subscribers can be cold-emailed, with an opt-out. A database of 8M partner contacts needs a UK GDPR lawful basis (legitimate interests assessment) and Article 14 notices. DMCC Act subscription rules apply.
